title: State the HTTP 400 for noContinuation on central-domain mailbox acknowledgements
outcome: The central-domain acknowledgement documentation explicitly says that the flag is rejected with HTTP 400 and directs callers to acknowledge the same receipt without the flag, preserving the owed continuation.
acceptance: The central-domain mailbox feature documentation names the HTTP 400 refusal and the unchanged-receipt fallback, consistent with the implemented acknowledgement route.
The existing central-domain focused behavior check still proves refusal without cursor advancement followed by a successful plain receipt ACK.
